glmv-pdf-to-ppt 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Converts any PDF into a structured, multi-slide HTML presentation.
- Automatically extracts images, plans slides, generates outline.json, and produces a concise markdown summary.
- Supports both English and Chinese PDF conversion to slides/PPT based on user intent.
- All outputs (slides, crops, outline, summary) are stored in timestamped subfolders for easy organization.
- Requires only Python (with pymupdf, pillow) and curl.
- Designed for privacy: all image processing/cropping is local; no cloud upload needed.
